summary: Comprehensive dashboard visualization of activity execution data with all metadata (invocations, impulses, tasks, outcomes, variants, costs, compositions)

currentState.description: Partial implementation exists with basic activity timeline in RecentActivity component and minimal analytics endpoints
currentState.dataFlow: OpenCode CLI → POST /v2/activities/executions → insert_execution() → SurrealDB activity_executions → GET /auth/orgs/{org_id}/activity (cache-aside Redis) → RecentActivity component (basic display)
limitations: No dedicated activity history page - only recent activity widget in cloud dashboard
No detailed activity execution breakdown with tasks, impulses, variants
No cost/duration visualization or filtering capabilities
No composition tree display for parent-child activity relationships
No impulse usage breakdown per activity
Analytics endpoints provide template-level aggregation but not execution-level detail
Dashboard only shows basic timeline with status, no expandable rows

desiredState.description: Full-featured activity history dashboard with comprehensive execution mapping, detailed task breakdowns, impulse tracking, cost visualization, and composition analysis
requiredComponents: Activity execution list with template names, execution IDs, timestamps, status, costs
Expandable row details showing task breakdown, impulse usage, outcomes
Visual indicators (color coding for success/failure, cost badges, duration timelines)
Filtering by template, status, cost, time period
Composition tree visualization for activity chains
Analytics aggregation endpoints for comprehensive data

components.currentBehavior: Records execution to SurrealDB activity_executions with basic metadata (activity_id, template_id, success, tokens, cost, duration, error details, impulses, component_changes)
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - already captures all required data including impulses_used, tasks metadata, variant info
components.gap: NONE - execution recording endpoint is complete

components.currentBehavior: Inserts execution record with full metadata to activity_executions table. Supports impulses (legacy correlation format) and impulses_used (MCP data flow format)
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - database operation captures all required fields
components.gap: NONE - SurrealDB schema supports comprehensive data storage

components.currentBehavior: Returns recent executions formatted as activity events for timeline display. Includes basic metadata (activity_id, template_id, status, duration_ms, cost_usd, tokens_total, error_message). Uses cache-aside pattern with Redis (60s TTL). Maps to analysis_completed/analysis_failed event types.
components.desiredBehavior: Extend to return comprehensive execution details including: (1) task_list with statuses and costs per task, (2) impulses_used array with types and budgets, (3) variant_id and selection reasoning, (4) composition data (parent_id, child_ids), (5) validation results, (6) outcome summary

components.currentBehavior: Aggregates template-level statistics (execution_count, success_rate, avg_cost, avg_duration, avg_tokens) grouped by template_id. Returns summary for all templates.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - template-level aggregation is sufficient for high-level metrics
components.gap: NONE - analytics endpoint serves its purpose for template statistics

components.currentBehavior: Time-series aggregation by period (1d, 7d, 30d, 90d) and granularity (hour, day, week). Returns execution counts, success rates, costs over time.
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - trends endpoint provides temporal analysis

components.currentBehavior: Stores activity content (template_definition, variable_bindings, reason, initial_state) to activity_content table for replay/learning
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - content storage supports detailed execution context
components.gap: NONE - activity content endpoint captures instructional state

components.currentBehavior: Records task execution start with state snapshot (task_execution_id, execution_id, task_id, task_index, state_before, status)
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - task-level tracking enables granular breakdown

components.currentBehavior: Updates task with completion data (status, success, state_delta, validation, duration_ms, tokens_used, cost_usd, error details)

validationStrategy.description: Use live dataset from devbob container (http://devbob.metabob.local) to validate accuracy of data representation
steps: 1. Execute multiple activities on devbob with varying outcomes (success, failure, partial)
2. Verify execution records are written to SurrealDB activity_executions table
3. Query analytics endpoints to confirm aggregation accuracy
4. Load dashboard Activity History page and verify execution list matches SurrealDB data
5. Expand execution rows and verify task breakdown, impulse usage, costs match actual execution
6. Test filtering by template, status, date range - verify results are accurate
7. Test sorting by cost, duration - verify ordering is correct
8. Compare displayed token counts and costs with actual LLM API usage
9. Verify variant selection reasoning matches Thompson Sampling data in Redis
10. For composed activities, verify composition tree displays correct parent-child relationships
playwrightTests: Navigate to Activity History page and verify page loads
Execute 5 activities on devbob and verify they appear in dashboard within 60s (cache TTL)
Click on execution row to expand and verify detail tabs are present
Apply filters and verify filtered results match expected criteria
Sort by cost DESC and verify highest-cost executions appear first
Search by execution_id and verify single result is returned
Verify cost badges display correct ranges
Verify duration timeline bars reflect actual execution times
